start: Menu, 'Messages & offers', gym with the member app on and app members

steps.action: Open 'Messages & offers'
user_sees: Title 'Messages & offers', line 'Messages, offers and wishes for your members, in the app and on WhatsApp', tabs 'Messages', 'Workout offer', 'Reminders'
Card 'Pick a message' with the kinds and 'Write my own'; below, 'Sent in the app'
must_not: A blank page
The Sent list of another gym

steps.action: Pick a kind, then one ready message
user_sees: The words of the message with boxes to fill in, a letter count, and who gets it
must_not: Words of the message picked before still in the boxes

steps.action: Fill in the boxes and choose who gets it
user_sees: The 'Send in the app' button turns on once every box is filled
must_not: The button on while a box is empty ('Fill in: …' must show instead)

steps.action: Tap 'Send in the app', read the line, tap 'Yes, send'
user_sees: Line 'Goes to <n> members in the app. Send now?' with 'Yes, send' and 'Not yet'; then 'Sending…'
Note 'Sent to <n> members in the app.'; the button is replaced by 'Sent in the app'; the message is on top of 'Sent in the app'
must_not: The message sent on the first tap with no question
Two messages from two taps
A count in the question that differs from the count in the note

start: Messages page (another kind: your own words)

steps.action: Tap 'Write my own' and pick a type of message
user_sees: Starting words for that type in the title and message boxes; a letter count under each (title 60, message 300)
must_not: Words the owner already typed replaced by the starting words when the type is changed

steps.action: Type a title and a message, tap 'Send in the app', then 'Yes, send'
user_sees: The same question and note as a ready message; the message shows in the Sent list with its type
must_not: The message saved with its end cut off without a word

start: Messages page on a server that knows groups and times (another kind: a group, at a later time)

steps.action: Choose a group (for example a plan or a batch) and a later time
user_sees: How many of the group have the app; 'Still loading who in this group has the app…' until the list is in
must_not: The send button on while the group's app members are unknown
The button on when nobody in the group has the app

steps.action: Tap 'Send in the app', then 'Yes, send'
user_sees: Line 'Goes to <n> members of this group in the app on <day and time>. Send then?'; then note 'Goes out <day and time> to <n> members in the app.'
In the Sent list: 'To a group', 'Goes out <day and time> · <n> members' and a 'Cancel' button
must_not: The message going to every app member
The message going out now
A time more than 30 days ahead accepted ('Pick a time within the next 30 days.')

start: Messages page (another kind: WhatsApp, one member at a time)

steps.action: Pick a personal message, or a ready message, and look under 'On WhatsApp'
user_sees: For a personal message: 'Sent on WhatsApp only, one member at a time, each with their own name and dates.'
Choice 'Not in the app' / 'Whole group' with counts, and the button 'WhatsApp one by one (<n>)'; 'Opens your own WhatsApp with the words typed in. It costs nothing.'
must_not: A count that includes members with no mobile number
The button on with 0 people

steps.action: Tap 'WhatsApp one by one' and send to two members
user_sees: A sheet that opens WhatsApp for each member with the words typed in; back on the page '2 of <n> done on WhatsApp for this message.'
must_not: A WhatsApp sent by the panel itself
One member's name or dates in another member's message
The done count lost on closing the sheet

start: An old link to Shop → Messages, or a nudge on Today that names a message

steps.action: Open the old address /shop/messages
user_sees: The Messages & offers page
must_not: A 'page not found'
The Shop orders page for an owner

steps.action: Tap a nudge on Today that suggests a message
user_sees: The Messages page with that ready message already picked and its starting group chosen
must_not: A message sent by the nudge itself
Another message picked

start: Messages page, an offer already sent today

steps.action: Pick an offer or event message and fill it in
user_sees: A warning line saying an offer or event already went today and members get at most one a day; 'Send in the app' is off
must_not: A second offer sent the same day
The WhatsApp way closed too

steps.action: Clear the title of an own message
user_sees: 'Write a title.' and the send button off
must_not: An empty message sent

steps.action: Send when the server refuses (the day's or week's limit reached in another browser)
user_sees: A red line: 'You already sent an offer or event today. Members get at most one a day. Send it tomorrow.' or 'You sent 3 offers or events this week. Members get at most 3 a week. Wait a few days.' or 'You sent 10 messages today. That is the most for one day. Send it tomorrow.'
must_not: 'Sent to …' shown for a refused message
A raw error code on the screen

steps.action: Send with a bad connection that times out
user_sees: A red line ending 'Check the Sent list below before sending it again.' and the Sent list re-read
must_not: The same message sent twice by trying again blind

start: Sent in the app list with one message sent now and one timed for later

steps.action: Look at the sent message some minutes later
user_sees: How many members have seen it, and a 'Take back' button
must_not: A seen count higher than the number it went to

steps.action: Tap 'Take back' and confirm 'Take back “<title>”? It is removed from every member’s inbox.'
user_sees: The card fades and shows 'Taken back'; no button is left on it
must_not: The message taken back without the question
The message still in members' inboxes
A way offered to send it again that sends a copy without a word

steps.action: On the timed message tap 'Cancel' and confirm
user_sees: The card shows 'Cancelled'
must_not: The cancelled message going out at its time

steps.action: Change one word of the message just sent
user_sees: The 'Sent in the app' mark turns back into the 'Send in the app' button
must_not: The same unchanged words offered for sending again on this open page

start: Messages page, signed in as owner

steps.action: Choose a group and read the question before sending
user_sees: Exactly who gets it: the count of this group's app members, or 'Goes to all <n> members in the app, not only this group. Send now?' on a server without groups
must_not: A message meant for one group reaching every member without that warning
Members of another gym counted

steps.action: Read the Sent list
user_sees: Each message with how many members have seen it
must_not: Other gyms' messages
A member's private data inside a broadcast message

steps.action: Send at the daily limit
user_sees: Members get at most one offer or event a day and three a week
must_not: A member's phone getting more offers than the limit says

steps.action: Look for 'Messages & offers' and open the messages address
user_sees: The page is titled 'Workout offer' ('Rewards for members who train') with only the tabs 'Workout offer' and 'Reminders'
must_not: A 'Messages' tab
The 'Pick a message' card
The 'Sent in the app' list

start: An old link to Shop → Messages, staff login

steps.action: Open the old address /shop/messages
user_sees: The Shop page with the orders list
must_not: The message composer
A blank page or a loop between two pages

steps.action: Try the messages address with a ready message named in it
user_sees: Still the 'Workout offer' page
must_not: A way for staff to send a message to members

start: Messages address, staff login, before and after the owner sends a message

steps.action: The owner sends a message; staff opens the messages address again
user_sees: The same 'Workout offer' page as before
must_not: The owner's sent message, its seen count or a 'Take back' button shown to staff

steps.action: Look for a way to read or take back what the owner sent to members
user_sees: None in the panel for staff
must_not: Staff able to send, read the Sent list or take a message back
A staff sign-in sending a message by a direct call that the server accepts
